# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.29

Workflow-column report candidate dated 2026-07-26.

## Explicit workflow columns

- Patient/RX Summary Excel and RX Report CSV/Excel include every configured
  workflow definition.
- Each workflow definition has separate **Status**, **Date**, and
  **Completed By** columns.
- Headers remain present when a workflow has no completion data.
- An applicable uncompleted workflow is labeled `Pending`; its completion date
  and user are blank because no completion event exists.
- Patients with multiple RX records remain on separate rows. A patient without
  an RX retains one patient row and has blank workflow cells.
- Packed multi-stage history cells were removed from these summary exports.

The **Complete History CSV** introduced in `next.28` remains the normalized,
lossless vertical history ledger with one linked row per completed or pending
workflow step and per historical business record.

## Safety

- No database migration.
- No business-data rewrite.
- Reports remain read-only and permission controlled.
- No proxy, origin, port, authentication, PBX, or RX Softphone change.

## Validation

- Public JavaScript syntax and encoding passed.
- Reports EJS rendering passed.
- PostgreSQL report/filter parity passed with structured action IDs, names, and
  dates.
- Isolated Chromium downloaded the real Summary Excel and verified Status,
  Date, and Completed By headers for all six configured workflow definitions.
- The complete isolated staging browser smoke suite passed.
